scientific_integrity: The theorem is supplied with a full mathematical proof, finite corroborating checks, and explicitly identified prior results. Self-review was completed; independent validation and independent audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: This proves only the ordinary third powers of equal-arm spiders with at least four edges per arm. The 2026 source proves the upper bound and poses equality as a conjecture for every power. Unindexed equivalent work is a priority risk; finite checker tests are not proof of all parameters.
title: Cubes of equal-arm spiders attain the spectral zero-forcing bound
